name: @vektorprogrammet/spike-alchemy-workflows
description: Throwaway spike: a membership renewal on Alchemy beta.83 Cloudflare Workflows, under `alchemy dev` (workerd, local engine) and in one short Cloudflare run, with a real PostgreSQL command. Results: spikes/alchemy-domain/REPORT.md.

scripts.cloud:deploy: CI=false alchemy deploy alchemy.cloud.ts --stage spike --profile production --yes
scripts.cloud:deploy:dry-run: CI=false alchemy deploy alchemy.cloud.ts --stage spike --profile production --dry-run --detailed --no-input
scripts.cloud:destroy: CI=false alchemy destroy alchemy.cloud.ts --stage spike --profile production --yes
scripts.cloud:destroy:dry-run: CI=false alchemy destroy alchemy.cloud.ts --stage spike --profile production --dry-run --no-input
scripts.test:cloud: devenv shell -- bunx vp test --config vite.cloud.config.ts
scripts.test:runtime: devenv shell -- bunx vp test --config vite.runtime.config.ts
